metadata.description: Local marketplace for llmTerminal-authored plugins. Lives in-repo so plugins are committed, reviewable, and toggleable via `claude plugin enable/disable --scope project` instead of living under root-owned .claude/skills/. Mirrors the orchestratorHero/plugins/hero-plugins pattern (see that marketplace.json for the same convention).

plugins.name: orchestrate-tournament
plugins.description: Two competing orchestration philosophies (full decompose-and-dispatch vs minimal direct-execution) wired as fork-and-select variants against HARNESS_PLAN slot #3/#6's experiments data pipe.
